'''''Riverserpent''''' is a riverboat that travels the [[River Eldar]], and <!---RIVER!!!--->[[Agni Neres]] is her captain. When he put in at [[Samara]], both [[Galadedrid Damodred]] and [[Masema Dagar]] attempt to conscript the ''Riverserpent'' for [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]'s use.{{ref/book|5|47}} Galad, who succeeded, finds Nynaeve, his half-sister [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]], and their group and escorts them to the docks. Before they leave, however, Nynaeve bullies Captain Neres into taking on several refugees at the docks, including [[Nicola Treehill]], [[Areina Nermasiv]], and "[[Moghedien|Marigan]]."{{ref/book|5|48}} After days on the river, the ''Riverserpent'' passes [[Boannda]] and the group disembarks near [[Salidar]].{{ref/book|5|49}}{{notes}}
